_comment: Server list feed. Intentionally empty for now.
This file is the PULL side of the design: the client only ever reads this document, so game
servers are never contacted directly by the browser and never see client traffic.
The PUSH side (a small relay service that servers heartbeat into, which then republishes this
document) is not built yet - see docs/SERVER_LIST.md for the intended contract.
The 'servers' array below documents the exact shape the client parses; add entries and the
Servers tab populates with no client change.
